title: Ned and the Water Wheel
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'wh' and 'ph'.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling noticing a big wooden water wheel beside the pond.
The wooden water wheel turning steadily in the flowing water.
Ned the duckling eyeing the turning wheel, keen to try it.
Ned the duckling climbing onto one of the wheel's wide paddles.
Ned the duckling being carried round and round as the wheel turns.
Ned the duckling looking a little dizzy and unsteady.
Ned the duckling hopping quickly off the turning wheel onto the bank.
Ned the duckling sitting very still on the grassy bank, steadying himself.
The water wheel continuing to turn on its own in the flowing water.
Ned the duckling flapping his wings happily at the turning wheel.
